title: What Makes Video World Model Latents Action-Relevant: Prediction over Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2606.07687v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video world models are increasingly used to provide predictive visual representations, yet it remains unclear which pretraining signals induce action-relevant structure in their latent spaces. We study this question through a unified probe-based evaluation across diverse encoder families, including image-only self-supervision, video pretraining with and without latent prediction, reconstruction-based autoencoders, diffusion models, and shortcut-forcing dynamics models. Using a common inverse-dynamics probing objective, we find that action-relevant structure is driven primarily by temporal video pretraining rather than pixel reconstruction fidelity: models with strong pixel decoding quality can exhibit near-zero action recoverability, while video-pretrained self-supervised encoders consistently achieve the best Pareto trade-off between visual fidelity and action prediction. translated_title: 是什么使视频世界模型的潜变量具有动作相关性：预测优于重建
translated_abstract: 视频世界模型（video world models）越来越多地被用于提供预测性的视觉表征，然而目前尚不清楚哪些预训练信号能够在其潜空间中诱导出与动作相关的结构。我们通过对多种编码器家族进行统一的基于探针的评估来研究这一问题，这些编码器家族包括仅图像自监督、带与不带潜变量预测的视频预训练、基于重建的自编码器、扩散模型以及强制捷径的动力学模型。使用共同的逆动力学探测目标，我们发现与动作相关的结构主要由时序视频预训练驱动，而非像素重建保真度：具有较强像素解码质量的模型可能表现出接近于零的动作可恢复性，而经过视频预训练的自监督编码器始终在视觉保真度与动作预测之间取得最佳的帕累托权衡。对 V-JEPA 与 VideoMAE 的进一步比较表明，大部分……
tldr: 该研究通过统一的探针评估发现，视频世界模型潜空间中与动作相关的结构主要由时序视频预训练（潜变量预测）驱动而非像素重建保真度，视频预训练的自监督编码器在视觉保真度与动作预测之间实现了最佳的帕累托权衡。
en_tdlr: Through unified probe-based evaluation, this study finds that action-relevant structure in video world model latents is driven primarily by temporal video pretraining (latent prediction) rather than pixel reconstruction fidelity, with video-pretrained self-supervised encoders achieving the best Pareto trade-off between visual fidelity and action prediction.
